assessment.rationale: Refilling stem cell reserves in aging tissues is unsolved; nothing comes near the Main KPI of 300,000,000 people with replenished stem cells. Rejuvenation of aged blood stem cells is preclinical: RhoA inhibition with Rhosin (Nature Aging 2025) and CASIN are ex vivo mouse or human-cell work, and the one clinical-stage attempt, Rejenevie AR-100, was suspended (https://lifespan.io/road-maps/the-rejuvenation-roadmap/rejenevie-therapeutics-ar-100). Muscle satellite-cell restoration remains in reviews and animal models with no approved therapy (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5271918). The furthest-advanced human work is adjacent, not the goal: allogeneic MSC infusion (laromestrocel/Lomecel-B) missed its 180-day primary endpoint in a 148-participant phase 2b and reports a 9-month walk-distance gain in a later analysis (https://www.biospace.com/longeveron-s-cell-therapy-shows-mixed-results-in-aging-frailty-investors-respond-favorably), which is symptomatic benefit rather than a replenished endogenous stem cell pool; plasma exchange reduced multi-omic biological age by about 2.6 years with fading effects (Aging Cell 2025). No open-source or openly published solution replenishes human stem cell reserves.

additionalSearches.query: rejuvenate aged hematopoietic stem cells therapy human clinical trial stem cell exhaustion 2025
additionalSearches.finding: No completed human HSC rejuvenation trial; RhoA/Rhosin and CASIN work is ex vivo and preclinical; Rejenevie AR-100 phase 2 suspended with no restart reported.

additionalSearches.query: Longeveron Lomecel-B aging frailty trial results mesenchymal stem cell
additionalSearches.finding: Phase 2b (n=148, NCT03169231) missed the 180-day six-minute-walk primary endpoint; a later publication reports a 63.4 m gain at nine months. Donor MSC infusion, not restored endogenous reserves.

additionalSearches.query: restore muscle stem cell satellite cell niche aging therapy approved treatment stem cell exhaustion review
additionalSearches.finding: Reviews describe niche-driven satellite cell loss and only partial rejuvenation in experiments; no approved clinical treatment restores satellite cell function.

additionalSearches.query: therapeutic plasma exchange or heterochronic factors restore aged stem cell function human trial results
additionalSearches.finding: Placebo-controlled TPE+IVIG trial (n=42) reduced multi-omic biological age by about 2.6 years, with effects not sustained; no stem cell replenishment endpoint.
